.panel-heading {
    display: flex; /* Use flexbox for layout */
    align-items: center; /* Center content vertically */
    justify-content: space-between; /* Distribute space between title and controls */
    height: 50px; /* Fixed height for the panel heading */
    padding: 0 10px; /* Add horizontal padding */
    box-sizing: border-box; /* Include padding and border in height calculations */
    overflow: hidden; /* Hide any overflowing content */
}

.panel-title {
    flex: 1; /* Allow title to grow and fill available space */
    white-space: nowrap; /* Prevent text from wrapping */
    overflow: hidden; /* Hide overflow text */
    text-overflow: ellipsis; /* Add ellipsis if text overflows */
    font-size: 14px; /* Adjust font size to make the title smaller */
    line-height: 1; /* Adjust line height for better text fitting */
    margin: 0; /* Ensure no extra margin affecting layout */
}

.panel-heading-controls {
    display: flex; /* Use flexbox for layout */
    align-items: center; /* Center content vertically */
    margin-left: auto; /* Push controls to the right */
}
